H1.def: a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application):--chief, (fore-)father(-less), × patrimony, principal. Compare names in "Abi-".

H3.def: from the same as «024»; a green plant:--greenness, fruit.

H5.def: of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes:--Abagtha.

H6.def: a primitive root; properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy):--break, destroy(- uction), + not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, × and surely, take, be undone, × utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

H8.def: active of participle of «06»; (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destructin:--perish.

H9.def: from «06»; concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades:--lost. Compare «010».

H10.et: the same as (09), incorrectly written for (11)
H10.def: the same as «09», miswritten for «011»; a perishing:-- destruction.

H11.def: intensive from «06»; abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades:--destruction.

H14.def: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent:--consent, rest content will, be willing.

H16.et: from (014) (in the sense of bending toward)
H16.def: from «014» (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus:--swift.

H17.def: from «014» (in the sense of desiring); want:--sorrow.

H19.et: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn)
H19.def: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword:--point.

H20.def: of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural):--melon.

H22.def: from «01» and «0410»; father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites:--Abiel.

H23.def: from «01» and «0622»; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite:--Abiasaph.

H24.et: from an unused root (meaning to be tender)
H24.def: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan:--Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).

H25.def: from «01» and «01391»; father (i.e. founder) of Gibon; Abi-Gibon, perhaps an Israelite:--father of Gibeon.

H26.def: or shorter Abiygal {ab-ee-gal'}; from «01» and «01524»; father (i.e. source) of joy; Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses:--Abigal.

H27.def: from «01» and «01777»; father of judgment (i.e. judge); Abidan, an Israelite:--Abidan.

H28.def: from «01» and «03045»; father of knowledge (i.e. knowing); Abida, a son of Abraham by Keturah:--Abida, Abidah.

H29.def: or prolonged Abiyahuw {ab-ee-yaw'-hoo}; from «01» and «03050»; father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah; Abijah, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses:--Abiah, Abijah.

H30.def: from «01» and «01931»; father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God); Abihu, a son of Aaron:--Abihu.

H31.def: from «01» and «01935»; father (i.e. possessor) of renown; Abihud, the name of two Israelites:--Abihud.

H32.def: or (more correctly) hAbiychayil {ab-ee- khah'-yil}; from 1 and «02428»; father (i.e. possessor) of might; Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses:--Abihail.

H33.def: from «044» with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer; -- Abiezrite.

H34.et: from (014), in the sense of want (especially in feeling)
H34.def: from «014», in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute:--beggar, needy, poor (man).

H35.def: from «014»; provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste):--desire.

H36.def: from «01» and «02898»; father of goodness (i.e. good); Abitub, an Israelite:--Abitub.

H37.def: from «01» and «02919»; father of dew (i.e. fresh); Abital, a wife of King David:--Abital.

H38.def: from «01» and «03220»; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah:--Abijam.

H39.et: from (01) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word
H39.def: from «01» and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan:--Abimael.

H40.def: from «01» and «04428»; father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites:--Abimelech.

H41.def: from «01» and «05068»; father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites:--Abinadab.

H42.def: from «01» and «05278»; father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious); Abinoam, an Israelite:--Abinoam.

H44.def: from «01» and «05829»; father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites:--Abiezer.

H45.et: from (01) and an unused root of uncertain derivation
H45.def: from «01» and and an unused root of uncertain. derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite:--Abialbon.

H47.def: for «046»; --angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.

H48.def: from «01» and «07311»; father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites:--Abiram.

H49.def: from «01» and «07686»; father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David:--Abishag.

H50.def: from «01» and «07771»; father of plenty (i.e. prosperous); Abishua, the name of two Israelites:--Abishua.

H51.def: from «01» and «07791»; father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason); Abishur, an Israelite:--Abishur.

H52.def: or (shorter) Abshay {ab-shah'ee}; from «01» and «07862»; father of a gift (i.e. probably generous); Abishai, an Israelite:--Abishai.

H53.def: or (shortened) bAbshalowm {ab-shaw- lome'}; from «01» and «07965»; father of peace (i.e. friendly); Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite:--Abishalom, Absalom.

H54.def: contracted from «01» and «03498»; father of abundance (i.e. liberal); Ebjathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.

H55.def: a primitive root; probably to coil upward:--mount up.

H56.def: a primitive root; to bewail:--lament, mourn.

H58.et: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy)
H58.def: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow:--plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.

H59.def: from «058»; a meadow; Abel, the name of two places in Palestine.:--Abel.

H61.et: apparently from (056) through the idea of negation
H61.def: apparently from «056» through the idea of negation; nay, i.e. truly or yet:--but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.

H62.def: from «058» and «01004» and «04601»; meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of Beth-maakah, a place in Palestine:--Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah,

H63.et: from (058) and the plural of (07848), with the article inserted
H63.def: from «058» and the plural of «07848», with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash- Shittim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-shittim.

H64.def: from «058» and the plural of «03754»; meadow of vineyards; Abel-Keramim, a place in Palestine:--plain of the vineyards.

H65.def: from «058» and «04246»; meadow of dancing; Abel-Mecholah, a place in Palestine:--Abel-meholah.

H66.def: from «058» and «04325»; meadow of water; Abel-Majim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-maim.

H67.def: from «058» and «04714»; meadow of Egypt; Abel-Mitsrajim, a place in Palestine:--Abel-mizraim.

H68.et: from the root of (01129) through the meaning to build
H68.def: from the root of «01129» through the meaning to build; a stone:--+ carbuncle, + mason, + plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-)stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).

H70.def: from the same as «068»; a pair of stones (only dual); a potter's wheel or a midwife's stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between):--wheel, stool.

H71.def: perhaps feminine of «068»; stony; Abanah, a river near Damascus:--Abana. Compare «0549».

H72.et: from (068) and (05828) with the article inserted
H72.def: from «068» and «05828» with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben-ha-Ezer, a place in Palestine:--Ebenezer.

H74.def: or (fully) nAbiyner {ab-ee-nare'}; from «01» and «05216»; father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite:--Abner.

H75.def: a primitive root; to fodder:--fatted, stalled.

H76.et: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth)
H76.def: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption):--blains.

H77.et: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam
H77.def: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous; Ebets, a place in Palestine:--Abez.

H78.def: from the same as «076»; splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite:--Ibzan.

H79.et: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapour), but used only as denominative from (080)
H79.def: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from «080»; to bedust, i.e. grapple:-- wrestle.

H80.def: from root of «079»; light particles (as volatile):--(small) dust, powder.

H85.et: contracted from (01) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous)
H85.def: contracted from «01» and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram:--Abraham.

H86.et: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel
H86.def: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel:--bow the knee.

H87.def: contracted from «048»; high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham:--Abram.

H88.def: plural of «0178»; water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert:--Oboth.

H89.def: of uncertain derivation (compare «090»); Age, an Israelite:--Agee.

H90.def: or uAgag {Ag-awg'}; of uncertain derivation (compare «089»); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings:--Agag.

H91.def: patrial or patronymic from «090»; an Agagite or descendent (subject) of Agag:--Agagite.

H92.et: f passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind)
H92.def: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a band, bundle, knot, or arch:--bunch, burden, troop.

H93.def: prob of Persian origin; a nut:--nut.

H94.def: passive participle of «0103»; gathered (i.e. received among the sages); Agur, a fanciful name for Solomon:--Agur.

H95.def: from the same as «094»; properly, something gathered, i.e. perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin:--piece (of) silver.

H96.et: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops)
H96.def: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir:--drop.

H97.def: dual of «096».; a double pond; Eglajim, a place in Moab:--Eglaim.

H98.et: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water)
H98.def: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds:--pond, pool, standing (water).

H99.et: probably from the same as (098) (in the sense of stagnant water)
H99.def: probably from the same as «098» (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively, sad:--pond.
